document: The timing class of every timing-basis text of the release (edition_meta.timing_basis, both distances), as analysis/build_runner_lookup.py writes it into editions.json.gz (column tb, the digit being the position in classes). A copy of lib/tiers.ts TIMING_BASES: scripts/verify-lookup.cjs holds every entry and every build to that module, and the build stops on a text that is not listed here. An edition with no timing-basis text is not_stated. The table is not of one release: a text a new release brings stops the build until lib/tiers.ts and this copy class it.
